clauses.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
clauses.text: Maintain an accurate and up-to-date inventory of all enterprise assets, including devices, servers, and endpoints, reviewed and updated on a recurring schedule.

clauses.title: Require MFA for Externally-Exposed Applications
clauses.text: Require multi-factor authentication, MFA, for all externally exposed enterprise or third-party applications, including remote access and VPN.

clauses.title: Establish and Maintain a Vulnerability Management Process
clauses.text: Establish and maintain a documented process to identify, assess, and remediate vulnerabilities on enterprise assets, reviewed on a recurring schedule.

clauses.title: Collect Audit Logs
clauses.text: Collect audit logs from enterprise assets and retain them, ensuring logging is enabled across systems and applications to support detection and investigation.

clauses.title: Perform Automated Backups
clauses.text: Perform automated backups of in-scope enterprise assets on a recurring schedule, and protect backup copies so they survive a ransomware or destructive event.
